# Eight-lesson allocation — Weeks11–12
Each lesson ~50–55minutes with short retrieval and exit evidence. Work/assessment replaces existing time; no extra project deadline or new summative assessment.
Week11 L1: 5min retrieval,15min six-table keys/dependencies,25min A design repair,5–10min feedback. L2:5min predict,15min model one join,25min B queries,5–10min explain NULL/grain. L3:5min retrieval,15min C transactions/connectivity/recovery,25min test/evidence critique,5–10min exit. L4:5min Unit3 retrieval,15min D/E/F stimulus and roles,25min explained case response,5–10min peer feedback.
Week12 L1: fresh T1/T2 query/data transfer; predictions, independent SQL, explanation and review. L2: fresh T3/T4 modelling/privacy/security; evidence-based extended response and feedback. L3: original24mark controlled formative sample in the already allocated theory-test slot; if replacing school's planned summative theory task teacher must adapt/approve, not count both. L4: mark/diagnose, explain corrections, independent changed-data retry, prioritise Week13–14 consolidation.
Model answers/reference scripts are openly downloadable within the private book and not protected as secure assessment materials. Use new teacher-controlled variants for any secure assessment. Samples aren't endorsed exams. Review symbols, scope, current law and assessment alignment; pack is not a full syllabus audit.
